item.description:
• Kit follows a conversation properly now: a short follow-up like "yes" no longer dead-ends with "I don't have that noted" when the answer is right there in the thread.
  • When a search finds nothing, Kit looks again using what you were just talking about before it says it has nothing.
  • Telegram in Settings reports the real state of the connection, so a saved token is no longer mistaken for a working channel.
